reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI workspace plugin focused on browsing files, viewing code, reviewing agent edits, and selectively accepting or reverting tracked changes; the README documents its file access, persistence, and revert behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供工作区文件浏览、代码查看以及按变更块审阅、接受或撤回代理编辑的工作区面板。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness Web UI workspace panel for browsing files, viewing code, and reviewing, accepting, or selectively reverting tracked agent edits.

capabilities: browses workspace files and displays file contents
tracks write and edit operations per session
persists edited-file snapshots and paths to profile storage
reverts individual hunks or whole-file changes
accepts or clears recorded change entries
deletes files created during the session when performing whole-file revert
